final: WITH joined AS (SELECT pa.player_id, p.bats FROM player_award AS pa JOIN player AS p ON pa.player_id COLLATE BINARY = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY), player_hand_counts AS (SELECT player_id, bats, COUNT(*) AS n FROM joined GROUP BY player_id, bats), hand_totals AS (SELECT bats, SUM(n) AS total FROM player_hand_counts GROUP BY bats), overall AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS total FROM hand_totals), shares AS (SELECT h.bats, h.total, CAST(h.total AS REAL) / o.total AS share FROM hand_totals AS h CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.total IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.bats, s.total, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN averages AS a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND s.share > a.avg_share
